NAME:
   rancher node drain - Drain a node: Rancher cordons it and evicts its pods

USAGE:
   rancher node drain [options] <node>

OPTIONS:
   --cluster id|name       target cluster id|name
   --delete-emptydir-data  also evict pods with emptyDir volumes; their emptyDir data is deleted
   --drain-timeout string  how long Rancher's drain may run, a duration such as 5m, from 1s to 3h in whole seconds (default 2m, as in Rancher; a large node can need more)
   --force                 also evict pods that no controller manages
   --grace-period seconds  seconds each pod gets to stop, 1 or more (default: each pod's own)
   --help, -h              show help
   --timeout timeout       wait timeout, a positive duration (default --drain-timeout plus 1m)
   --wait                  wait until Rancher reports the drain done or failed (default true; --wait=false returns once the server accepts the request)

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --allow-deprecated          allow writing to a deprecated resource
   --apply                     apply the change
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --dry-run                   preview the changes without applying them
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
   --yes                       confirm a destructive change
